title: Scott Speedman Has Finally Settled Into Leading Man Status With ‘R.J. Decker’
summary: The star and executive producer explains how season two will reveal new sides to his ex-con turned P.I., why he will always make time to return to 'Grey's Anatomy,' and the status of a potential 'Felicity' reunion: "If all of us could push a button and do something — whether it's a 90-minute movie for Netflix, or six episodes for whoever — we'd all be game…
